long:
Miriam Wiener, MS, MPH, founded S.T.E.P.S. Nutrition Group to provide quality, evidence-based nutrition therapy for women and girls. 

A licensed dietitian-nutritionist and board-certified nutrition specialist with over 30 years of experience, she is known for her warm approach and sympathetic ear, combined with highly effective tools and techniques that work.

Miriam is a graduate of UCLA and the UNC Gillings School of Global Public Health, where she developed an award-winning diabetes prevention and management program based on her trademarked S.T.E.P.S. to Nourishment® framework.

She is a grant reviewer for the IHS Department of Health and Human Services Division of Diabetes Treatment and Prevention, and the founder and executive director of Nourishment of the Soul, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization dedicated to bringing foundational, evidence-based nutrition education to women and girls.

Miriam has been featured in the Jewish Journal of Greater Los Angeles.
